lives_works: Lagos, Nigeria, and Ijebu, Ogun State

items.title: In Minor Keys
items.venue: Venice Biennale 2026 (61st International Art Exhibition), Venice

items.text: Founded in Nigeria by Yinka Shonibare CBE RA, with the sister charity Yinka Shonibare Foundation (UK); an evolution of Guest Projects, his London artist residency project
Lagos residency building opened (designed by Elsie Owusu with Nihinlola Shonibare)
Second site on a 54-acre working farm near Ikise, Ijebu-Ode, designed by Papa Omotayo
Residencies of up to three months and public programmes; G.A.S. Fellowship Award
Partners include Royal College of Art, South London Gallery, Goodman Gallery, Tiwani Contemporary, British Council, Pro Helvetia and ART X
